The '''[[Domani]] manor house''' is the last of the various "manors, estates and other remote hiding places" that [[Rand al'Thor]] used in the weeks between the capture of [[Semirhage]]{{ref/book|12|1}} and his arrival in [[Bandar Eban]].{{ref/book|12|29}}

==Activities==
The manor and its grounds were the site of several notable events:
*Most of [[Aviendha]]'s make-work "punishment"{{ref/book|12|11}}{{ref/book|12|15}}{{ref/book|12|26}}
*The [[bubble of evil]] that caused [[Adrin]] to die "bleeding" an incendiary "charcoal-like substance"{{ref/book|12|11}}
*Sorilea's observation of Semirhage,{{ref/book|12|14}} interrogations of Semirhage by [[Sarene Nemdahl]] and various other [[Aes Sedai]],{{ref/book|12|17}} and [[Cadsuane]]'s humiliation of Semirhage{{ref/book|12|17}}
*Rand's short-lived sleep while he met with [[Moridin]] in a "dream"{{ref/book|12|15}}
*Rand's confession to [[Min]] concerning the voice of [[Lews Therin Telamon]]{{ref/book|12|15}}
*Min's suggestion to Rand that he must destroy the [[Seven Seals|seals]] in order to "rebuild the [[Dark One]]'s prison"{{ref/book|12|15}} and Lews Therin's confirmation{{ref/book|12|22}}
*Rand learning that the [[Seanchan]] agreed to an actual meeting between [[Tuon]] and himself{{ref/book|12|15}}
*[[Amys]] and Aviendha learning that the Seanchan held [[Shaido]] as ''[[damane]]''{{ref/book|12|15}}
*Semirhage's short-lived escape and use of the [[Domination Band]] to nearly force Rand to kill Min{{ref/book|12|22}}
*Rand's commensurate first use of the [[True Power]]{{ref/book|12|22}}
*The exile of Cadsuane{{ref/book|12|23}} and the deaths of [[Daigian]],{{ref/book|12|23}} Semirhage,{{ref/book|12|22}} and [[Elza Penfell]]{{ref/book|12|22}}
*The first known conversation between Min and Aviendha since Rand's visit to Caemlyn wherein he was bonded to the three women{{ref/book|12|26}}
*Aviendha's rejection of her "punishments" and departure for her second [[Wise One]] visit to [[Rhuidean]]{{ref/book|12|26}}

==See also==
*[[House Pendaloan manor]], where Rand rested after the [[cleansing of saidin|cleansing of ''saidin'']]
*[[Natrin's Barrow]], which was [[balefire]]d by Rand in an effort to kill [[Graendal]]
*[[Osana's hunting lodge]], where [[Rodel Ituralde]] united [[Taraboner]]s and [[Domani]] against the Seanchan
